text_block_list.text:
Since it's Valentine's Day tomorrow, I
decide to
give Нарита Таисин a present.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
But what should I get her since she doesn't like
candy?

text_block_list.text:
I end up picking out some cookies
coated in
bitter chocolate and head
back.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hm? What's that?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: What? Oh... That's today?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: No... Well, maybe. Kind of.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I don't really exchange chocolate with
friends or
anything.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Hang on, is that seriously for me?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: ...Huh. Okay.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Uh... Thanks, I guess.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
That night, while I'm relaxing in my
room, there's
a knock at the door.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hey... You in there?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Have you had dinner yet? If not, I
brought you
some food.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I stare at Taishin in confusion and notice
that
she's holding a container filled with
a dry curry
dish.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I haven't eaten yet, so I'm starving, and I
happily
accept the food. Still...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: And not only that...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Why are you acting like it's some kind of
huge
shock?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list:
Because I didn't know you were such a good
cook!

text_block_list.text:
Not really. I just learned how to cook
since my
family runs a business. My
parents were too busy
to look after me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
You don't have to make such a big deal
about it.
It's just a dry curry...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I'm not lying or exaggerating. The curry
has a
mellow sweetness and depth to it
that makes me
wonder if it has some
secret ingredient.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess that's better than being
told it
tastes disgusting.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Anyway, I've got a curfew to keЭпизод Later.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин runs off as if desperate to
leave.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm so hungry and the curry is so amazing
that I
clean my plate before realizing it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, no problem.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: A brief silence hangs in the air.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Say...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
You know that thing you said about me
believing
in myself?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I once told her that I'd believe in her as
long as
necessary until she believed in
herself too.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And I would believe in her even if it took
a
lifetime.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Well... Hypothetically speaking...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
What if I said that I believe in myself
now?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: What would you do?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Would you call it quits because you've
done your
job, and that's it? You're
gone?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't say it in so many words, but I
guess if
she's gained confidence in
herself, then that's
enough.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I open my mouth to speak, but she
interrupts me
before I can get the words
out.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: No, don't say anything.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Not yet. I don't want to hear it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Sorry. I'm going back.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин runs off as if desperate to
leave.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The taste of the curry leaves a lingering
hint of
sweetness in my mouth.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The taste of the curry leaves a hint of
bitterness
in my mouth.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
